questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Oslo university had a great program for Geography, and at the same time had a great social program in place which i hold very high when it comes to studying, which also ended up being the reason why i chose this university over others.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: i came a little later then some other students, which made it easy for me atleast to get information from them and if i had any other questions i could always just ask the school.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: mostly from other student who was in the same situation as i was in. But we also had help from the university if any big questions where there.

questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: housing was very easy to find since there are some big organisations that work with the universities to host most if not all the international student by the same place.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: that Norway can be a bit expensive so always be prepared to have a little saved up before going to Norway.

Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: i did have a few issues with registrastion but that was do to me not checking my email dayli.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: i had help from both my own university, the host university and older students who themself had been to oslo.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: i got 2 out of the 3 courses i wanted, so i would say fairly successful.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: do it well in advance do to some courses having a limited number for students on them, so you have to be quick.

questions.answer: BA

questions.answer: The geography courses was to the level that i expected, maybe a little under but then the other courses was a bit over the level i expected.

questions.answer: pretty much the same style where you were mostly free to be there or not but it was heighly recommended to be there to follow the course.
